# Offline chart asset

Apache ECharts 6.0.0 is vendored from its versioned npm distribution, mirrored by
jsDelivr. Its version matches the Apache release tag. The offline report
inlines this file; it never loads a CDN, account, collector, or remote font.

Source: https://github.com/apache/echarts/tree/6.0.0
Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@6.0.0/dist/echarts.min.js
License and notice are included beside the asset. SHA256SUMS records exact bytes.
